order: newest week first; entries by section, then date, then name

entries.title: Mastercard Agent Pay for Machines
entries.detail: Summary now uses Early Access from the 20 October 2026 announcement: buyer and seller APIs, a toolkit, a sandbox, and documentation. The pages read on 2026-11-17 do not say it is not available commercially. In the Cloudflare Connect pilot, Base settled on-chain and BVNK settled in fiat or stablecoins.

entries.title: Microsoft Agent Framework
entries.detail: Summary now says the Go SDK is in public preview, requires Go 1.26 or later, and lives in the separate microsoft/agent-framework-go repository.

entries.title: Pydantic AI
entries.detail: Summary now says the Gateway is one key for every model with real-time cost monitoring and budget control, and that Harness lists Spend Limits and Guardrails. Pydantic Graph stays a separate package.

entries.title: Socure Agent Intelligence
entries.detail: Gap note citations that used the StreetInsider copy now use the Socure newsroom page. That page states allow, step up, or block, and cryptographic chaining and proof of possession. StreetInsider returned HTTP 403 on 2026-11-17.

entries.title: 10 cent payment dates
entries.detail: Undocumented fee and total lines on the page, CSV, JSON quotes, and llms output use each row's fee checked date. Rows checked 2026-11-09 still print 2026-11-09.

entries.title: Coinbase Agent Controls
entries.detail: Summary now states Agent Controls set in the Coinbase account and enforced on Coinbase servers: a USD cap per trade, a 24 hour volume cap, and a stop on new trades past a portfolio loss threshold. The ChatGPT plugin confirms each order on a card. The read only cell says portfolio access is chosen on the approval screen.

entries.title: Exchange access FAQ periods
entries.detail: The FAQ that lists how each server runs now ends every item with one period. A cell that already ended in a period no longer gains a second one.

entries.title: HYPR AgentPass
entries.detail: Listing added. Each agent is bound to a named human supervisor who signs in through Entra, Okta, Ping, or any OIDC provider. Agents start with zero access. Tool credentials stay in one gateway and are issued as short-lived, single-tool session tokens. A kill switch refuses the next request, including a session already running.

entries.title: Incode Know Your Agent
entries.detail: Listing added. Five modules tie an agent to a verified person and a mandate of scope, amount, and duration. GovFaceMatch compares a live face with the photo on the person's state DMV record. The customer can revoke an agent, and pending actions stop.

entries.title: Lightspark Agent Accounts
entries.detail: Listing added. A customer's agent gets paid, pays people, and spends from a Grid Global Account the customer owns. Grid checks each action and runs it, refuses it, or holds it for approval. Grid does not run the agent.

entries.title: Open Policy Agent
entries.detail: Docs still say OPA decouples policy decision making from enforcement, accepts arbitrary structured data such as JSON as input, and evaluates Rego policy. The repository page shows the Apache-2.0 license.

entries.title: smolagents
entries.detail: Docs still describe code agents that write actions in code, with sandboxed execution via Modal, E2B, or Docker.

entries.title: x402
entries.detail: The x402.org page still says a server without payment responds with HTTP 402 so the client pays and retries. The CDP how it works page still describes the facilitator verifying and settling. The repository is Apache-2.0.
